en.title: Maximum Contiguous Groups with Equal Left and Right Shoes
en.description:
Partition all the shoes into contiguous, non-overlapping segments, each with the same number of L and R, and find the maximum number of segments. Every shoe must belong to a segment.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site.
en.input: One line containing a string of L/R of length 2 to 100000; the numbers of L and R are guaranteed to be equal.
en.output: Output the maximum number of segments.
en.explanation: LRLR splits into LR and LR; LLRR can only form one segment; RLLRRL splits into three segments: RL, LR, RL.
hints: Count L as 1 and R as −1, scan the prefix sum, and cut a segment every time it returns to 0.
